# montecarlo_hive_credentials (Resource)

Hive credentials are the HiveServer2 address and user Monte Carlo signs in with. A Data Lake warehouse's connection uses them. Hive needs no secret.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Hostname of the HiveServer2.
- `user` (String) User Monte Carlo signs in as. Hive takes no password.

### Optional

- `auth_mode` (String) How Monte Carlo signs in. Omit it for `SASL`.
- `db_name` (String) Database Monte Carlo connects to.
- `port` (Number) Port the HiveServer2 listens on in binary mode.

### Read-Only

- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
